member.name: T:HW4AzureFunctions.AttachmentZipFunction
member.summary:
Azure Function triggered by messages in the attachment-zip-requests queue. For each message the function:
Deserialises the payload.
Lists all blobs in the attachment container named with the note ID.
Creates an in-memory zip archive containing all attachment blobs.
Uploads the archive to the {noteId}-zip container as the blob named by ZipFileId.
If processing fails the message is retried up to maxDequeueCount times (configured in host.json) before being moved to the poison queue attachment-zip-requests-poison.
